name: ClassRevision metadata is read-only and monotonically published

input.fixture_ref: fixture: {actions: ["observe A.active_revision metadata", "commit one successful structural open of A and one failed candidate", "retain old revision and Method references", "compare revision numbers and commit_id metadata", "attempt user mutation/reactivation of old revision"]}

applicability.reason: Blocked by a REAL defect, not a missing surface. `Reflection::Class.revision(A)` now exists and reports both `number` and `commit_id`, which is what this row was held for. Measuring with it exposed the defect: C017 makes an origin revision 1, and a freshly declared Class answers 3, because `mutate_candidate` publishes its own revision whenever no candidate is staged. Recorded in docs/spec-defects-v1.md under IRIS-V1-RUNTIME-C017.

expect.status: Origin revision number is 1; one successful structural publication increments A's per-Class revision and receives one runtime-local commit_id; failed candidates consume no revision number; retained old revision metadata remains executable/readable while referenced; user mutation or reactivation is rejected.
